clips.title: The story
paras: In Duskwood's shadowed northeastern hills, Manor Mistmantle lies north of Darkshire. Once a family homestead, the estate has fallen into ruin, where ghouls prowl under the command of its infamous master.

West of Beggar's Haunt, Manor Mistmantle's ruined grounds are choked with decay. Vicious ghouls prowl there, guarding the broken house. In the untended garden, a solitary, sorrowful blossom called the Tear of Tilloa is the only sign of living beauty on the entire property.
